extract_patches_basic: extract patches from a batch of images using specified sizes, strides, and rates
extract_patches_dilated: extract dilated patches from images using rates for atrous convolution-style sampling
extract_patches_padding: extract patches from images with custom padding strategy like SAME or VALID
extract_patches_arbitrary_dim: extract patches from arbitrary-dimensional image tensors beyond standard 4D batches
extract_patches_reshape: extract patches and reshape output to match tf.image.extract_patches interface
